zh: 美國議員就民用航空器交通資訊接收設備達原則協議
en: US lawmakers reach an in-principle agreement on civil aircraft traffic receivers.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：迦納空軍接收Dassault Falcon 6X公務機、漢莎航空A320商務艙改四座並排、首批6架飛機明年3月上線、RTX旗下柯林斯航太在印度動工興建螺旋槳維修廠、2029年初啟用
en: Aviation briefs: Ghana Air Force takes delivery of Dassault Falcon 6X executive jet; Lufthansa fits four-abreast Premium Business Seats on six Airbus A320s; RTX's Collins Aerospace begins work on new propeller MRO facility in India

zh: 航空短訊彙整：美軍首批常駐海外F-15EX戰機抵日本嘉手納　開啟駐日機隊換裝、中東航空接收首架空中巴士A321XLR客機、Azul Conecta首架SkyCourier投入亞馬遜營運　與巴西石油公司簽四年運輸合約
en: Aviation briefs: First permanently based US Air Force F-15EX fighters arrive at Kadena in Japan; Middle East Airlines receives its first Airbus A321XLR aircraft; Azul Conecta deploys first Cessna SkyCourier on Petrobras services in Brazil

zh: 菲律賓航空敲定15架波音787-10訂單，另有5架購買權
en: Philippine Airlines finalizes an order for 15 Boeing 787-10s, with rights for five more.

zh: 塞爾維亞空軍MiG-29墜毀，飛行員罹難
en: Serbian Air Force MiG-29 crashes, killing its pilot.

zh: 星宇航空規劃2027年3月開航臺北－雪梨－奧克蘭航線
en: STARLUX Airlines plans a Taipei–Sydney–Auckland route from March 2027.

zh: 航空短訊彙整：Azul首架SkyCourier飛機投入亞馬遜載運石油工人、A380新創航空Global Airlines遭英國法院下令強制清算　唯一客機仍停放法國、中國商飛CE-25A電動飛機完成首次載人試飛　19座設計邁入下一階段
en: Aviation briefs: Azul airline puts first Cessna SkyCourier to work flying oil crews in the Amazon; UK court orders Global Airlines into compulsory liquidation; lone A380 remains stored in France; COMAC CE-25A makes first piloted test flight as electric commuter project advances

zh: 航空短訊彙整：美國航空業者預期感恩節疏運近2900萬人次　11月29日航班最繁忙、菲律賓航空確定訂購15架波音787-10 另有5架購買權、達美航空砍波音767航線 北美業者擴增新線
en: Aviation briefs: US airlines expect nearly 29 million Thanksgiving flyers, with November 29 the busiest day; Philippine Airlines confirms order for 15 Boeing 787-10s, with rights for five more; Delta Cancels 767 Routes as North American Carriers Expand

zh: 航空短訊彙整：巴拿馬航空客機與UPS貨機在邁阿密國際機場（MIA）地面碰撞 兩名乘客輕傷、RwandAir尋求擴大空中巴士A330機隊 盼拓展國際航網、日本財務省傳提出五年防衛預算 F-35採購可能受影響
en: Aviation briefs: Copa Airlines and UPS aircraft collide on the ground at Miami International Airport (MIA); two hurt; RwandAir seeks Airbus A330 fleet growth to expand international network; Japan's reported defense budget proposal could affect F-35 purchases

zh: 航空短訊彙整：COMAC的CE-25A電動飛機完成首次有人駕駛試飛、達美航空執行長批希斯洛拆分決定「短視」誓言力抗搬離維珍航廈
en: Aviation briefs: COMAC’s CE-25A electric aircraft completes first piloted test flight; Delta CEO calls Heathrow move to split airline from Virgin Atlantic "short-sighted"
